scenario_summary: Negative example: accurate report of the To/Westminster PD incident.

claims.claim_text: Surveillance footage showed the subject striking vehicles and a fire hydrant with the pole.
claims.explanation: Surveillance footage of pole strikes matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject was holding a metal pole in his right hand.
claims.explanation: Pole in right hand confirmed by DA letter.

claims.claim_text: Officers identified themselves and commanded the subject to drop the pole.
claims.explanation: Verbal identification and commands match DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject advanced toward officers in an aggressive posture with the pole raised.
claims.explanation: Subject advanced with pole raised. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: I deployed my TASER, which did not have the desired effect.
claims.explanation: TASER deployed without effect. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: I then transitioned to my duty firearm.
claims.explanation: TASER-to-handgun transition documented in DA letter.

claims.claim_text: I fired five rounds from my duty weapon.
claims.explanation: Five rounds fired. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: Officers handcuffed the subject and began administering medical aid.
claims.explanation: Handcuff and medical aid. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject communicated in Vietnamese during portions of the encounter.
claims.explanation: Vietnamese communication documented in DA letter.
